name: Noir Alley
desc: A rain-slick film-noir back alley: a single sodium streetlamp throws a flickering cone onto wet cobbles while venetian-blind shadows rake a dark wall and fog drifts through the beam.

scale.doc: cone + fog element scale vs design

style.doc: render philosophy: chiaroscuro noir / cyan schematic wireframe / wet neon reflections / thermal false-color / sumi ink wash

act.doc: multi-minute program: calm haze / building rain / flickering blackout
